title: What a carrier is
summary: A carrier has one typical copy and one changed copy of a gene for a recessive condition. Carriers are healthy. Everyone carries a few changed genes; it is very common and nothing anyone did caused it.
body: Being a carrier matters mainly when planning a family. If both partners carry a changed copy of the same gene, each pregnancy has a chance of the child being affected. If only one partner is a carrier, children are not affected by that recessive condition, though some may be carriers too. A carrier result is not a diagnosis.
